advice_items.quote: Be fearless... don't be afraid to fail.
advice_items.summary_en: Be fearless and don't be afraid to fail in business.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持无畏心态，不要害怕商业失败

advice_items.summary_en: Stay clean and avoid illegal shortcuts like dealing drugs.
advice_items.summary_zh: 守住底线，切勿沾染毒品等违法勾当

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.summary_en: Scale from seven to eight figures by simply having a great product.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠过硬的产品品质实现千万级营收突破

advice_items.summary_en: Work hard and never, ever quit as a business owner.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拼命努力工作，在创业路上绝不轻言放弃

advice_items.quote: Conserve your cash... opportunities happen, you hopefully have some cash you can take advantage of them.
advice_items.summary_en: Conserve your cash so you are ready to seize opportunities when they arise.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保留充足现金储备，以便抓住突发商业良机

advice_items.quote: You want to do it, but not that bad... be able to walk away at the same time you're going to be able to want to do it.
advice_items.summary_en: In negotiations, want the deal enough to pursue it, but always be willing to walk away.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判想成单但别太急切，必须随时敢于离场

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年家族在电力行业创业取得巨大成功并出售公司，随后其父亲于2002年买下休斯顿德州人队（NFL扩军球队），以此进入职业体育领域。
guests.role_or_title: Owner of the Houston Texans (NFL Team)

advice_items.quote: You've got to build a team around you that are going to cover all those weaknesses... you need to be working on the business.
advice_items.summary_en: Build a team to cover your weaknesses and work on the business rather than in it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 组建团队弥补自身短板，脱离执行才能做大

advice_items.quote: Don't be fooled by all the Ferraris and the Pateks and all that BS.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't get fooled by luxury status symbols like Ferraris and Patek watches.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别被法拉利名表等外在炫耀的假象所迷惑

advice_items.quote: Every dollar that a company spends must have an ROI attached to it.
advice_items.summary_en: Never spend a dollar in your business without a directly calculable ROI.
advice_items.summary_zh: 公司每一分钱支出都必须能直接核算投资回报

advice_items.quote: Every dollar that you're making, if you're doing the right thing, it's got to stay in that company to be able to grow.
advice_items.summary_en: Leave every dollar of profit inside the business to build retained earnings and fund growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将公司盈利全部留存再投入以实现持续扩张

advice_items.quote: Find something you're truly passionate about. Everything else after that is secondary.
advice_items.summary_en: Find something you are truly passionate about; everything else comes second.
advice_items.summary_zh: 找到你真正热爱的事物，其余一切皆为次要

advice_items.quote: I wasn't always the smartest person in the room, I was just the SOB that refused to quit.
advice_items.summary_en: You don't have to be the smartest person in the room if you simply refuse to quit.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不必是屋里最聪明的人，但要做最不肯放弃的人

guests.first_money_or_break: 白手起家，成长过程中曾身无分文，创业初期毫无资金，靠21%高息应收账款保理贷款维持现金流，并坚持将每周利润留存公司以滚大资产负债表，最终获得6%-8%的银行传统授信额度，28岁时年收入达300万美元，现公司年营收达3亿美元。
guests.guest_name: River Oaks Labor Force Management Founder
guests.role_or_title: Founder & Owner of a Labor Force Management Company
guests.zero_start_advice: 从零开始要先找到自己真正热爱的事物并绝不放弃；同时趁早学习基础商业财务知识，把赚到的利润留存在公司里再投资，不要盲目追求豪车名表等外在炫耀。

advice_items.quote: The doctor's biggest mistake [is] they don't learn the business of medicine... money is what sinks a lot of practices.
advice_items.summary_en: Doctors in private practice must learn the business of medicine early to stay afloat.
advice_items.summary_zh: 医生创业必须趁早学习商业管理，避免资金断链

advice_items.quote: If you have a private practice, you need to have that niche and to stay afloat.
advice_items.summary_en: If you run a private practice, you need a specific niche to stay afloat.
advice_items.summary_zh: 开设私人诊所需要找准细分定位才能站稳脚跟

advice_items.quote: Learn business early on, not because you're after money... how to give good service to your patients, but stay afloat.
advice_items.summary_en: Learn business not out of greed, but to deliver great patient care while keeping the practice solvent.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学商业不是为了捞钱，而是为了服务好患者

guests.guest_name: Houston Lung & ICU Specialist Private Practice Owner
guests.role_or_title: Lung & ICU Specialist & Private Practice Owner
guests.zero_start_advice: 给从医者的建议是：趁早学习商业管理知识，不要只停留在受雇思维；若开设私人诊所，必须平衡好对患者的优质医疗服务与诊所自身的商业生存。
